statement: Let visitors discover public Bitbucket repositories and let local developers manage source, issues, pull requests, pipelines, members, and repository settings without contacting Bitbucket or causing production effects.

actors.description: Anonymous visitor browsing public Bitbucket pages and repositories.
Authenticated local account that creates and changes owned repositories.
Repository member who reviews pull requests.
Workspace or repository owner who manages access and settings.

simulations: Account recovery stays local and sends no real email.
Pipeline execution and retry are deterministic local simulations with visible logs.
Collaborator invitations select seeded local accounts and send no message.
out_of_scope: Real account creation, email delivery, invitations, source pushes, webhooks, OAuth, and identity-provider calls
Live Git transport, package registries, runners, deployments, and production CI execution
Billing, subscriptions, payment credentials, and payments
Any runtime request to Bitbucket, Atlassian, Sourcetree, VS Code, or third-party services
